transcript.content: You are a helpful assistant with access to various tools. Use the tools provided to complete the task. Be concise and efficient. If you need to perform multiple steps, do them in sequence.
Find all .log files in /workspace that are older than 30 days and move them to /workspace/archive directory. Create the archive directory if it doesn't exist.

I'll help you find and archive old log files. Let me do this step by step.

**Step 1: Check the current workspace structure**

<tool_call>
{"name": "bash", "arguments": {"command": "ls -la /workspace/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'Workspace directory not found'"}}

**Step 2: Create the archive directory and move old log files**

<tool_call>
{"name": "bash", "arguments": {"command": "# Create archive directory if it doesn't exist\nmkdir -p /workspace/archive\n\n# Find .log files older than 30 days and move them to archive\necho \"=== Searching for .log files older than 30 days ===\"\nfind /workspace -maxdepth 1 -name \"*.log\" -type f -mtime +30 -print\n\necho \"\"\necho \"=== Moving files to /workspace/archive ===\"\nfind /workspace -maxdepth 1 -name \"*.log\" -type f -mtime +30 -exec mv -v {} /workspace/archive/ \\;\n\necho \"\"\necho \"=== Done ===\""}}
</tool_call>
